restoration: Reuse paid source practice under identical old-case conditions; every new case requires real practice. Any source edit invalidates its earlier coverage.
author_experience: Use the inherited method and its saved practice traces, including failures. Do not append or repeat the eight earlier repair investigations. Only the unchanged original archive and published self-contained method enter any target.
practice_protocol: Six unchanged source practices plus three anonymous public apparatuses from the historical conditional/window laboratory. All have 72 paid prefix rows and 96 blind confirmation rows. Old cases keep 360 observations, new ones allow 2240. The per-case criterion is 1e-10 for old cases and the historical 1e-6 for new cases. All allow 32 program invocations. No confirmation labels reenter a frozen program.
comparison: Retention: unchanged original and revised programs on ALL ten earlier targets, with the original seeds, prefix, limits and 1e-10 criterion. Selection: revised program, same-cost random selection and same-cost maximum prediction variance on twelve fresh conditional/window targets (four parameter blocks, three stages). These three arms share source, candidates, fitting and tools; only their experiment choice is intervened. The original one-control method is not an applicable new-task baseline.
outcome_protocol: Retain predictive publication separately from the experimental-design objective. The latter requires a current-source supported-rival forecast, actual discriminating acquisition and authored evidence readout before submission, followed by accepted prediction. Refuting all candidate instances and refitting is allowed. No tool-call quota or accuracy improvement over the fixed method is required.
terminal_order: Finish both frozen research cohorts before generating any terminal labels.
failure_policy: Retain every completed success and failure; resume only unfinished targets. All registered arms stop research before terminal scoring.
scope: Frozen published 14-case method revision: 26 previously opened regression tasks and 8 registered targets from 4 parameter groups. Compare the published 13-case baseline on the same 8 targets. No consumer LLM, author revision, source fits or author-history transfer.
continuation: New author allowance, unchanged 14 practices and 26 target slots. Restore every paid draft, failure and current source. Shared runtime tool-result recording and factual practice feedback are repaired; Luna must revise its own method. Previous costs are retained, not reset or recharged.
source_cost_scope: Confirmed online development costs and prior author phases are retained separately.
transfer: Only the published program and original archive enter targets; the successful online source and practice fits are author-only. All research stops before scoring.

previous_confirmed_source.scope: Retained source provenance; its costs remain in the existing historical phases.

parameter_registration.prerequisite: Actual published same-source14/14method; freeze exact source before any target evidence.
parameter_registration.parameter_scope: Four new apparatus parameter groups, each with two dependent interaction-weight conditions (-0.65,1.6); historical square response and source window_width3 retained. Tests new parameters in the learned window family, not unseen structure or independent learning replications.
parameter_registration.comparison: Both frozen methods use the same original source archive, task, prefix seeds, per-case allowances and scoring. Previous26cases retain their prior effective caps. No consumer LLM, scientific source edits, fitted source data or author history in target workspaces. All research in both arms stops before terminal scoring.
parameter_registration.execution_reuse: Existing published_source, prepare_published_targets, frozen_transfers, score_frozen and paired frozen orchestration.
parameter_registration.failure_policy: Keep every completed target including failures. Resume only unfinished work; no target-informed author revision in this frozen batch.
parameter_registration.evaluation_scope: Each laboratory retains its public trajectory horizon; nested_response confirmation and terminal segments have up to64steps.

paired_baseline.scope: Complete both published research arms before either terminal scoring.
